narrative.intro: Acquisition Logistics reported $609M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Acquisition Logistics won 5 awards so far, producing an average award size of $122M and obligations up 131.5% year over year. Acquisition Logistics saw most of FY2026 obligations concentrate in a single market: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services, which recorded $609M. Acquisition Logistics sold services to two major buying agencies in FY2026 to date: Department of Homeland Security with $598M and Department of Defense with $10.8M. Acquisition Logistics has a recent fiscal history of smaller annual obligations: FY21 $8.4M, FY22 $4.1M, FY23 $6.7M, FY24 $4.1M, and FY25 $263M. Acquisition Logistics also shows a minor presence in Other Support Activities for Water Transportation with $311K in FY2026 to date. Acquisition Logistics current-year totals are partial and cover fiscal year to date activity. Acquisition Logistics award-value totals in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations, per reporting notes.
